Name: Lucys Farmer Portrait
Author: LucyLovegood
Description:
[size=3]Originally, I made these portraits for using in my gameplay.


[size=3]
[size=3]All artwork in this mod is my own original creation [size=3]and belong to me.[/size]
AI tools were used during the creation process, with all final work done by me
No existing mods, artworks or characters from other creators were used or copied.[/size][/size]

This project is part of my personal learning process.
I am actively teaching myself pixel art and portrait creation step by step and wanted to share this work so others can enjoy it as well.
[/size]


[size=3][b][size=3]Installation:[/size]
[/b]
1. Make sure you have the latest versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20713]Farmer Portraits for 1.6[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]  installed.

2. Download this mod and extract the folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory, just like any other mod.

3. Launch the game via SMAPI and configure the settings as shown in the screenshots.[/size]



[size=3]
🔹 [b]Credits[/b]

[i]Code / Framework:[/i]

I adapted the code of content.jason file from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20713?tab=files&file_id=85088](CP) Farmer portrait reactions template[/url]﻿ to my assets.
All credit should go to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mistyspring]mistyspring[/url]﻿.

[i]Art & Portraits:
[/i]
All portraits, emotions and outfits were created and edited by me and are my original work.

UI:[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35996]


[*] DBB's Victorian Gothic User Interface

[/url]

This mod is offered for free, and everyone is free to decide whether they wish to download and use it.
Feedback is welcome as long as it remains constructive, on-topic [size=3]and respectful 💜[/size]



[/size]This is my first mod. I spent a very long time on the portraits.
I've also already planned a new map with many new NPCs and have drawn and planned quite a bit for it.
Unfortunately, my job keeps me very busy and I also have significant health limitations.
If anyone has any tips regarding modding, please let me know.
